guidance.inspection: Reconstruct the operative protected-information definition from its preamble, incorporated definitions, alternatives, exclusions, form rules, and linked conditions. Test explicit identification as a universal proposition: marking or identification required for every protected item supports it; reasonable-understanding, circumstances, nature, or automatic-inclusion alternatives oppose it; mere absence of a marking rule is unresolved. For technical-only scope, use subjects within the controlling definition, not unrelated recitals or uses; protected business, financial, marketing, personnel, customer, or operational information opposes it. Express oral or verbal coverage supports oral inclusion even when later confirmation is required. Cite all independently responsive definition members and necessary governing language.

operations.rationale: Tightens universal-quantifier and definition-chain handling after repeated false entailments from broad confidentiality language, while retaining a compact full-context demonstration with both contradiction and genuine whole-document NotMentioned annotations.

guidance.inspection: For each proposition locate an operative permission, exclusion, restriction, ownership rule, or reservation, then verify actor, object, recipient class, purpose, polarity, conditions, and necessary preamble. Independent development and lawful third-party receipt are distinct exceptions; neither substitutes for the other. Sharing requires an operative disclosure or access rule, with any incorporated recipient definition: employees support employee sharing, named nonemployee advisers, agents, consultants, contractors, counsel, or representatives support third-party sharing, and an exclusive employee-only rule opposes nonemployee sharing. Limited use requires a use restriction; copying, disclosure, access, or a limited license alone does not decide it. No-licensing may follow from express no-right, no-license, ownership, or reservation language; access or evaluation alone is unresolved. Preserve independently responsive clauses.

operations.rationale: Separates frequently conflated permissions and requires operative links, addressing false sharing findings and incomplete evidence without imposing vocabulary-specific vetoes.

guidance.inspection: Decide return or destruction, copy creation, post-disposition retention, and survival separately while reading each clause with its lead-in, trigger, alternatives, exceptions, and cross-references. Return-or-destruction requires a mandatory disposition tied in the operative rule to termination, expiration, completion, conclusion, rejection, or another stated end of the relationship; do not transfer a separate termination event into a request-only duty. Copy permission must be affirmative, including a necessary-purpose exception; a prohibition conditioned on later consent opposes permission, and archival persistence is not copy creation. Post-disposition possession requires an express retention exception; an unqualified duty covering all material or copies opposes it even when request-triggered. Survival requires an identified obligation continuing beyond an end event. Preserve all governing and independently responsive evidence.

operations.rationale: Repairs observed trigger transfer, retention-as-silence, and copy-versus-retention errors, using a compact source whose annotations distinguish request-only return, unqualified return, and unresolved lifecycle propositions.

guidance.inspection: Inspect the complete document separately for agreement secrecy, compelled-disclosure notice, personnel non-solicitation, and reverse engineering. Agreement secrecy is supported by an operative prohibition covering the agreement, its existence or terms, or discussions or negotiations; definition-based coverage also requires the linked secrecy duty. Compelled-disclosure notice requires legal, regulatory, governmental, judicial, subpoena, or administrative compulsion linked to notice, information, or consultation for the disclosing party; a bare disclosure exception is unresolved. Non-solicitation requires an operative restriction concerning the disclosing party's employees, officers, consultants, agents, or comparable personnel, with its lead-in, duration, consent terms, and exceptions; securities proxy solicitation and unrelated customer restrictions do not qualify. Reverse engineering requires an operative reverse-engineering, decompilation, or disassembly prohibition concerning protected information or an embodying object. Absence remains NotMentioned; preserve all responsive evidence.

operations.rationale: Removes the proxy-solicitation ambiguity and reinforces linked-definition and compelled-notice requirements after visible false positives and missed agreement-confidentiality evidence.
